stemMd: A delivery policy permits express shipping if and only if an order is prepaid and weighs at most5kg. A fragile order also requires protective packaging for any shipment. Order X is prepaid, weighs4kg, and is fragile but unpackaged. Order Y is unpaid, weighs3kg, and is not fragile. In column "X", select the single change sufficient to allow X to ship express. In column "Y", select the single change sufficient to allow Y to ship express. All unstated attributes remain unchanged.
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.
explanationMd: X satisfies both express-specific conditions but needs packaging to satisfy the rule for fragile shipments. Y meets the mass limit and has no packaging requirement, but must be prepaid. Each proposed change resolves exactly the unmet condition for that order.

distractorRationale.x-b: This fails the express weight limit and leaves packaging unresolved.
distractorRationale.x-d: It already meets the weight limit but remains unpackaged.
distractorRationale.y-a: Y already meets the weight limit and remains unpaid.
distractorRationale.y-b: This still leaves the prepayment requirement unsatisfied.
distractorRationale.y-d: Y is not fragile and still fails prepayment.
